vae:
WAN VAE (WAN::WanVAERunner) — same 3D video VAE as Wan/Qwen-Image/Longcat-Avatar. Upstream expressed this via sd_version_uses_wan_vae(); the FORK has no such helper and instead dispatches the VAE inline via two lambdas in stable-diffusion.cpp. The integrator must add sd_version_is_lingbot_video(version) to BOTH OR-lists:
  (a) create_vae() WAN branch — fork lines ~1012-1015 (grep anchor: `return std::make_shared<WAN::WanVAERunner>`): add `|| sd_version_is_lingbot_video(version)` to the `sd_version_is_wan(version) || sd_version_is_qwen_image(version) || sd_version_is_anima(version) || sd_version_is_longcat_avatar(version)` condition.
  (b) create_tae() WAN branch — fork lines ~972-975 (grep anchor: `return std::make_shared<TinyVideoAutoEncoder>`): add `|| sd_version_is_lingbot_video(version)` to the same style OR-list (only matters if a TAE/taew is supplied; harmless otherwise).
No new VAE class or factory code needed — WAN::WanVAERunner already takes the fork (backend, params_backend, tsm, prefix, decode_only, version) ctor.
conditioner:
LLMEmbedder (the fork's LLM text/vision conditioner, same class Qwen-Image/Ideogram4 use). Fork construction (NO model_manager):
  std::make_shared<LLMEmbedder>(backend_for(SDBackendModule::TE), params_backend_for(SDBackendModule::TE), tensor_storage_map, version, "", enable_vision)
enable_vision is true iff any tensor name starts_with "text_encoders.llm.visual." (matches upstream). model_version_to_str[] name: append "LingBot Video" (see extra_integration — must land at the same index as the enum entry).
notes:
WHAT I CHANGED in src/model/diffusion/lingbot_video.hpp (only file edited):
  1. LingBotVideoRunner ctor converted to fork convention: added `ggml_backend_t params_backend` as 2nd arg; dropped `std::shared_ptr<RunnerWeightManager> weight_manager` and `const char* model_args` (and the `SD_UNUSED(model_args)`); base init is now `DiffusionModelRunner(backend, params_backend, prefix)`. Matches FluxRunner/Ideogram4Runner exactly.
  2. Fixed compute<float>: upstream called `GGMLRunner::compute<float>(get_graph, n_threads, false, false, false)` (THREE bools) — the fork's GGMLRunner::compute has only `(get_graph, n_threads, bool free_immediately, bool no_return=false)`. Changed to `(get_graph, n_threads, false)`, matching every fork sibling (ideogram4/qwen/flux). Without this the runner would not compile once instantiated.
  DiT block definitions were left untouched per instructions. Verified: no remaining model_manager / weight_manager / RunnerWeightManager / model_args references; ctor matches the base.

RISKS / MUST-VERIFY (why confidence=medium, not high):
  - The premise "the DiT blocks already use the shared primitives" is FALSE in this fork for THREE symbols: DiT::patchify_3d/unpatchify_3d, Rope::gen_lingbot_video_pe, and GGMLRunnerContext::bind_backend_tensor_data. All three are absent from the fork's shared files (dit.hpp / rope.hpp / ggml_extend.hpp). They are NOT in my edit scope and NOT among the three files the wiring process touches, so unless someone ports them (exact snippets/anchors in extra_integration.A) the build FAILS the instant lingbot_video.hpp is #included. This is the dominant risk — flag to whoever owns shared-file changes.
  - Primitives that ARE present and fine: ggml_argsort_top_k (used in te/llm.hpp), ggml_mul_mat_id, ggml_ext_ones_like/chunk/slice/timestep_embedding, Flux::modulate (5-arg with skip_reshape bool — matches), Qwen::TimestepEmbedding, Rope::attention, sd::ggml_graph_cut::mark_graph_cut.
  - Enum/name-array index coupling: model_version_to_str[] is indexed by SDVersion; the appended enum entry and appended string must share an index. I recommend appending (before VERSION_COUNT / at array end) to avoid renumbering the whole fork enum.
  - VAE: fork routes VAE inline (no sd_version_uses_wan_vae); must edit the create_vae/create_tae lambdas (see vae field), not a category function.
  - model_args: upstream threaded sd_ctx_params->model_args into the runner; the fork runner convention has no such param, so it is dropped. If lingbot_video actually needs model_args-driven behavior, that capability is not wired.
  - Not build-tested (server policy forbids building; task forbids it too). All findings are from source inspection of the checked-out fork branch + upstream/master.
